question: What does Leda Voss report about whether Marin Holt wrote the ridge register?

sources.body_html:
Report.

Written by Quentin Moss.

Leda Voss said, “Marin Holt did not write the ridge register.”

Report.

Written by Quentin Moss.

Leda Voss did not say, “Marin Holt did not write the ridge register.”
